Second pass with the same trader. I read him back the two things HSA would
not accept from the first call and he pinned both of them down.

XAUUSD, London session, same two charts as before. The 4H decides which way
he is allowed to trade. The 5m is where he gets in.

What he meant by trend on the 4H is the 50-period moving average of the
close crossing the 200-period moving average of the close. When the 50
crosses up through the 200 he is long-only. When it crosses down through the
200 he is short-only. Golden cross and death cross, nothing else.

The cross is a context, not an entry. He does not buy the cross itself. What
it does is open a window: from the 4H bar on which the cross completes he
will take 5m entries in that direction for the next thirty 4H bars. If none
arrive in that time he drops the idea and waits for the next cross.

What he meant by a breakout on the 5m is the 5m candle closing beyond the
highest high of the previous twelve 5m candles by a tenth of that range's
height, where the range height is that highest high minus the lowest low of
the same twelve. That is the long side. The short side is the mirror: a
close below the lowest low of the previous twelve by the same tenth of the
range height. The close is what has to be beyond the level. A candle that
pierces the level and closes back inside the range is not a break to him and
he will not take it.

The 5m break has to agree with the 4H cross. If the 4H has him long-only and
the 5m breaks downward, that is not his setup and he stands aside.

One entry per cross. Once he has taken the 5m break the window shuts and he
waits for the next 4H cross.
